business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

business.body:
- Described as "India's largest producer of micronized minerals" and, in the CMD profile, as "India's largest producer of micronized industrial minerals and specialty chemicals, with a presence in over 65 countries".
- Self-described as "the pioneers in the field of Industrial Minerals in India", built on "expertise in Micronization", now "expanding our portfolio into the world of Performance Minerals, Speciality Chemicals and Functional Additives catering to the niche segments".
- R&D moat framed around a "devoted R&D and Product Application Centre"; the state-of-the-art R&D Centre at Waghodia, Vadodara is "recognized and approved by DSIR, Govt. of India".
- Management frames the strategic backdrop around the global 'China plus one' strategy, "positioning the company as a reliable global player", and cites "import substitution capabilities" as an expected benefit of the capex.
- Group structure spans subsidiaries (20 Microns Nano, 20 Microns Malaysia, 20 Microns FZE Sharjah, 20 MCC, IQ Marbles, GTLQ, 20 Microns Vietnam) and German JVs (Dorfner 20 Microns for coloured quartz; Sievert 20 Microns Building Materials for tile adhesives and construction chemicals).
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Acquisition] "Expanded its global presence by entering into definitive agreements to acquire 100% equity interest in GTLQ SDN BHD and IQ Marbles SDN BHD, a well-established limestone extraction and processing businesses based in Ipoh, Malaysia"; both appear in the group structure as Malaysian limestone reserves and processing.
- [JV] "Entered into JV Agreement with Sievert Baustoff GmbH, Germany for Manufacturing of Construction Chemicals", with a "new joint venture company incorporated as Sievert 20 Microns Building Materials Private Limited for construction chemicals and building related products".
- [JV] Entered into a JV agreement with Dorfner "to further strengthen 20ML's international presence"; Dorfner 20 Microns is described as a German JV supplying Coloured Quartz.
- [Demand backdrop] Management flags FY26 headwinds: "subdued paint industry demand, prolonged monsoon impact on post-Diwali offtake, and geopolitical uncertainties arising from the West Asia conflict".
- [Outreach] Exhibited at PlastIndia 2026 (New Delhi, 5-10 Feb 2026) showing functional fillers, anti-blocking agents and specialty additives for polymers, and at PaintIndia 2026 (Mumbai, 19-21 Feb 2026) showing engineered nanoparticle-based inorganic additives.

drhp.business: 20 Microns Limited mines, beneficiates and micronizes industrial minerals (talc, kaolin, calcite, dolomite, silica) and processes them into specialty minerals, functional additives, construction chemicals and agriculture (MinFert) products for customers in paints and coatings, plastics and polymers, specialty chemicals, rubber, construction and agriculture. The Company sells over 50 specialty products domestically and through an international business serving export markets, supported by subsidiaries and joint ventures in minerals processing and building materials.

risks.note: Rated High impact: fluctuations in mineral availability, mining regulations, energy costs and logistics expenses may impact production costs and margins; mitigated via diversified/planned sourcing, captive mining reserves, strategic inventory management and long-term supplier partnerships.

Rated Medium impact: a slowdown in paints, polymers, rubber, ceramics or construction sectors could affect volumes and profitability; mitigated via a diversified end-market portfolio, expansion into specialty applications and customer diversification.

Rated Medium impact: trade restrictions, freight disruptions, currency volatility and geopolitical developments may affect export competitiveness and supply chains; mitigated via a balanced domestic-export mix, market diversification and active treasury management.

Rated Medium impact: delays in capacity expansion, integration of overseas assets, or operational disruptions may impact growth objectives; mitigated via structured project governance and performance monitoring systems.

Rated High impact: increasing environmental regulations, ESG expectations and compliance requirements may affect operating costs and market access; mitigated via ISO/Responsible Care practices and regular environmental audits.

Rated Medium impact: increased digitalisation exposes the Company to cybersecurity threats, data breaches and operational disruptions; mitigated via strengthened IT governance, cybersecurity protocols and disaster recovery systems.

sk.overview: The company operates in the Indian contract mining and logistics (coal) industry, as framed by the CRISIL Report titled "Contract mining & transportation" (June 2026). Mining and quarrying accounted for ~2.1% of India's GVA (at constant prices) in fiscal 2025, with coal and iron ore contributing about 86% of that. Coal is the backbone of India's energy supply, accounting for ~56% of India's primary energy mix and ~75% of total power generation, and is a key raw material for power, steel, sponge iron, cement, paper and brick-kiln industries.
